scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,API -c green,cyan "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace functions
scripts.firebase:emulators: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:start
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 deploy --only hosting,functions
